title: dragons, romance readers, book theories, gritty, and hockey. i’m stil...
transcript: I never could have imagined i'd ever be talking about my favorite book boyfriends, at an NHL arena, but here we are. I was invited to be a panelist for the philadelphia flyers fourth wing game. You know, the famous romance book by rebecca yarros? I love this series and it was such an honour to be invited. And it's wild to me because I started my career working for the national hockey league. Back then, the idea that the NHL would ever embrace romance readers, mostly women, just did not feel possible. And now NHL teams like the flyers are hosting events where over five hundred romance readers can yap about books. There are our favorite romance recs and, of course, our fourth wing theories. We even got a special message from rebecca yarros herself. It was so fun, and I only mentioned heated rivalry twice. It was a win for me. But that wasn't even the end of it. The flyers turned the arena into an immersive bezzioth war college experience. They had a parapet and hair braiders and you could write messages to liam. My favourite part was the real dragons of the bearded variety. It was a great party. And then it was time for the game. They put us in a really cool creator suite that they completely checked out. We got there early so I could watch warm ups. I love warm ups. And the flyers are playing the rangers, which is really fun. For me, I was probably most excited to see gritty. I have been obsessed with him for years. Unfortunately for the flyers, the game did not go great, but the vibes were amazing and they did get a couple of goals. I fully lost my mind when I found out that team USA figure skater isabelle is in the crowd. I love her. And we got some fourth wing shout outs which is very exciting. But the highlight for me for sure was meeting gritty. I was so star struck. He's the best mascot in professional sports, there is no question. I haven't been to an NHL game in years and it felt so good to be back at a sport I love. And I hope we see more initiatives like this, ones that take women seriously and invite them into NHL arenas in new ways. Truly thank you to the flyers for inviting me and making the night so special. I will never forget it, even if the rangers did win. Sorry. Yay! Great day!
